versions.changelog:
Initial release of trademark-certificate-ocr skill.

- Provides OCR recognition for trademark registration certificates.
- Supports structured JSON output with recognition results and confidence scores.
- Requires SCNET_API_KEY for API authentication.
- Accepts local image files (jpg, png, pdf, etc.) for input.
- Handles basic error messages and includes rate limit guidance (10 QPS).
- Includes detailed configuration and troubleshooting instructions.
